Karnataka withdraws controversial park land bill after protests

The Karnataka Cabinet has decided to withdraw a controversial bill concerning park land. The decision comes after significant public protests against the bill. The government plans to reintroduce an amended version of the legislation. This move follows public opposition that led to the withdrawal.
